3:A GitHub Action that runs a durable [pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) coding agent on issues and pull requests, triggered by comments. Each issue or PR is one long-running conversation: follow-up comments continue it, several teammates can talk to it at once, and its full history is stored in your repository as git commits on `refs/pi/threads/<number>`.
10:- 💾 State in git, no external storage: each step is a commit on `refs/pi/threads/<number>`, pushed at every turn and once more in an `if: always()` step
48:    # One run per issue/PR at a time (see "Durable threads" below).
53:      contents: write       # push code and refs/pi/threads/*
370:git fetch origin 'refs/pi/threads/42:refs/pi/threads/42'
371:git log --oneline refs/pi/threads/42            # one commit per saved step
372:git show refs/pi/threads/42:batch.json | jq .   # what the latest step stored
377:#### Durable threads
379:Every issue or PR is one pi conversation, stored with [pi-durable](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-durable) as a chain of git commits on `refs/pi/threads/<number>` in your repository (a custom ref: it doesn't show up as a branch). The storage backend is in [`src/storage`](src/storage).
388:  git fetch origin 'refs/pi/threads/*:refs/pi/threads/*'
389:  git log --oneline refs/pi/threads/42          # one commit per stored step
390:  git show refs/pi/threads/42:batch.json | jq   # the newest step's records
394:- **Pruning**: `git gc` won't shrink a thread (its history is reachable). Delete a finished thread with `git push origin :refs/pi/threads/42`.

87:#### The agent's GitHub token and git identity
88-
89-The agent's tools (`bash`, and the tools of pi-durable extensions) get two things a runner lacks, each only if the workflow hasn't set it:
90-
91-- **`GH_TOKEN`**, set to `github_token`, so `gh` works. It is left alone when `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` is already in the environment.
92-- **A git identity** for `git commit`: `GIT_AUTHOR_NAME`/`GIT_COMMITTER_NAME` `github-actions[bot]` and `GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL`/`GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL` `41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`. Each is left alone when it is set, or when git has `user.name` (for the names) or `user.email` (for the emails) configured. To commit as someone else, set those variables in the step's `env` or run `git config user.name/user.email` in an earlier step.
93-
94-`bash` gets them in its environment only. pi-durable extensions run inside the action, so when there are any, the action sets the variables in its own process environment too (after installing the extensions). The token isn't new to the agent: `actions/checkout` already stores it in the checkout's git credentials, where any tool can read it; this just lets `gh` find it. Give `github_token` only the permissions the agent should have.
95-
96-### Inputs
97-
98-All inputs are defined in [`action.yml`](action.yml). Default values are centralized in [`src/defaults.ts`](src/defaults.ts).

444-Collaborators are not allowed by default. Add `COLLABORATOR` to `allowed_associations` if you want outside collaborators to trigger pi.

446:The agent's tools get `github_token` as `GH_TOKEN` and a `github-actions[bot]` git identity when the workflow sets neither (see [the agent's GitHub token and git identity](#the-agents-github-token-and-git-identity)), so the token's permissions are the agent's. pi extensions loaded with `extensions` run with the job's permissions; see [Providers from pi extensions](#providers-from-pi-extensions). For pi-durable extensions, keep `trust_project` off unless you trust everyone who can change the repository, and see [Questions on GitHub](#questions-on-github) for who can answer their questions.

README.md:268:- **`trust_project`** (default `false`) tells the extension it may load and run the repository's own configuration (for pit: `.pi/pit.json` and `.pi/functions`). Anyone who can push a branch or open a PR can change those files, so turn it on only for repositories whose code you would run anyway, and never for workflows that run on untrusted PRs.
